'''Spinach''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop|garden vegetable]]. It can be planted in all seasons, and its leaves are edible raw or [[cooking|cooked]].

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[preferences|like]] spinach for its ''leaves''.

[[File:Spinacia oleracea Spinazie bloeiend.jpg|thumb|center|300px|Admired for its ''leaves''.]]
